bureaux.name: Le hall des bureaux
bureaux.alt: The busy ground-floor hall of the village offices, painted in ink and gouache: through the open entrance door on the far left an autumn street glows; a woman carries her firm's gold prize on a silver tray; a little girl in a party hat spins at the office party; a businesswoman with her briefcase closes a deal; a lady leads a little white pony through the hall; seven colored doors (purple, teal, mustard, coral, slate blue, olive and navy) line the back wall; a gray donkey in glasses works at his desk; a man in a cap reads out a thick report; a young assistant hurries over with a first-aid box; a film director calls through his megaphone; the boss strides about in a tall white chef's hat, and jolly old Pa sits on his carved throne.

doors.hint: Go through the coral door up to the first-floor office

zooms.label: la table
zooms.hint: Look closer at the big desk in the middle of the hall

table.name: La table du hall
table.alt: Close-up of the big desk in the hall: little wooden figurines sit round a tiny meeting table; a very long list unrolls over the edge of the desk past the businesswoman's arm; two smiling eggs stand side by side in their cups; a toy tractor parks on a sealed contract; a little worker figurine throws up both arms; a conga drum stands by a small beach picture, and a little wizard with his empty hat holds up a sign showing a magnifying glass over a briefcase: he is looking for work. A nervous stand-in waiter balances a teacup near the rim of his tray in front of the desk. The pony's head and the donkey's ears peep in at the bottom.

etage.name: Le premier étage
etage.alt: The first-floor landing on job-interview day, seen from the top of the stairs under a round skylight, painted in ink and gouache: a woman in green hands over the bill for the little toy factory with its smoking chimney; a proud woman lifts her money plant, now taller than she is; at the writing desk with its figurines, toy van and sealed package a woman clacks a big abacus; a young candidate holds out her rolled application; across the landing a nervous young man is handed a cup of tea as he steps in for his interview, a worker in overalls waves his lunchbox, a sandy cat on its hind legs holds up a placard, a lawyer in a black gown greets visitors at the door of his wood-paneled cabin, a Roman in a toga is paid in a big bowl of salad, and papers fly from the open top drawer of a narrow filing cabinet by the right wall.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the coral door down to the hall

zooms.label: l'écritoire
zooms.hint: Look closer at the writing desk on the left

zooms.label: le classeur
zooms.hint: Look closer at the filing cabinet on the right

classeur.name: Le classeur
classeur.alt: A close-up at the first floor's filing corner on a cool autumn morning: ocher plaster wall, honey wood paneling and leaves on the parquet. At the left edge a tall wooden filing cabinet has a drawer pulled out; a clerk on a ladder flings blank papers that swirl through the air like a flock of birds, a girl in a blue dress runs to catch them in a wicker basket and a small boy stuffs letters into a canvas sack. On the right the office bustles: a bumblebee flies off with a tiny briefcase; a boy films a toy ship in a washbasin harbor with an old box camera; a neat little official in a gold-braided cap salutes; two labrador puppies ride their little cart; two doctors in white coats confer; a top-hatted employer holds out a golden key; a police officer holds up a stamped decree; raspberries are gathered on a saucer on a stool; and a typewriter on a small desk is chained shut with a padlock.

ecritoire.name: L'écritoire
ecritoire.alt: A close-up of the writing desk on the first-floor landing, the big abacus at the back: a woman counts gold coins one by one into her little envelope; two carved wooden figurines shake hands on a deal while their little blue-and-white van waits behind them; and a pair of hands presses down on a brown paper package packed so tight it bulges, tied with string and sealed with a big blob of red wax, while tiny wooden figurines cheer all round.

direction.name: La direction
direction.alt: The directors' boardroom on a stormy night, painted in ink and gouache: lightning flashes in the tall windows and rain lashes a stone statue crumbling by the window; a secret agent in a trench coat walks out through the open door with his briefcase; a tabby cat sits in a clawfoot bath with a resigned sigh; a little girl beams at the fresh pink ice cream that replaces the cone she dropped; two businesswomen shake hands firmly under the chandelier; a sorry black dog lies by a pair of chewed shoes; a boy pours lemonade at his own little stand; a supplier wheels in a cart of boxes; three grinning old comedians in bowler hats walk arm in arm; and on the big desk at the front a model office tower, a girl with her pay envelope and a line of ducklings wait.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the olive door down to the hall

zooms.label: le pupitre
zooms.hint: Look closer at the carved desk on the right

pupitre.name: Le pupitre de la direction
pupitre.alt: A close-up of the big desk in the stormy-night boardroom: on the left a model glass office tower with a tiny cheerful worker waving from every window; a young woman tears open her fat pay envelope and gold coins tumble into her hands; a kind gray-haired boss gently hands a card back to a sad young worker hugging his box of belongings, a pot plant and a mug poking out; and on the right a coordinator in a vest points the way for a neat line of fluffy yellow ducklings marching across the desk.

metiers.name: La galerie des métiers
metiers.alt: The trades fair in the cobbled courtyard of the offices, under bunting and balloons, painted in ink and gouache: by the door on the left a young woman climbs a ladder carrying the basket of a little striped hot-air balloon; a doctor kneels to give a boy on a stool a spoonful of medicine; a secretary bird stands at its little writing desk with a quill; on the stage under the striped awning a boy potter lifts his first blue vase, a worker in overalls cheers beside a red toolbox tied with a bow and an old alchemist holds up his glowing masterpiece by his bubbling flasks; in front, a male nurse tucks a blanket round a smiling old man in a wheelchair, a tabby cat with a shiny badge on its collar sits on the stage edge, a young assistant in a lab coat holds out a frying pan, and on the corner counter a beaver sits beside a blue teapot.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the purple door to the hall

zooms.label: le comptoir
zooms.hint: Look closer at the desk on the right

comptoir.name: Le comptoir des métiers
comptoir.alt: A close-up of the little corner counter at the courtyard trades fair, under the striped awning: a proud beaver carries a big log for the stick dam he is building; beside it an owl perches watching a blue teapot pour a curl of steaming special tea into a cup; and on the right an engineer in a yellow hard hat tightens the last bolt on a giant brass clockwork engine full of cogs.

services.name: La galerie des services
services.alt: The services gallery at lunchtime, painted in ink and gouache in deep perspective, autumn leaves blowing across the parquet from a teal door standing open on the left onto golden trees. A maid in a frilly apron rushes forward with one round bun on a silver tray; a caretaker pins up a big floor-plan chart of the building; a farmer's hay cart tips and spills; a child clerk stamps a single paper beside a slow tortoise; a specialist lies on his tummy peering at an ant through a magnifying glass; a girl architect holds a house blueprint over her head; a goose in a diplomat's collar waddles past; a man on a ladder peers through a long brass tube; a servant in a powdered wig sends his covered silver dish flying; and a jolly baker juggles croissants. The tall carved cabinet stands open at the far end.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the teal door to the hall

zooms.label: la vitrine
zooms.hint: Look closer at the tall carved cabinet at the far end

guichet.name: La vitrine des services
guichet.alt: A close-up of the services' carved honey-oak cabinet, its doors thrown open onto one little stage with a pale-blue painted sky: a nanny in a white apron hands a toddler a fresh round cookie; a well-off couple on a red velvet sofa laugh as they share one giant burger; in the middle a calm gray-bearded psychiatrist takes notes while a nervous young man on a couch waves his hands as he talks; a magician sweeps off his top hat and a white rabbit pops out among sparkles; and a grocer beside a crate of vegetables hands a single green pea to a small boy.

apprentis.name: La galerie des apprentis
apprentis.alt: The apprentices' workshop gallery on open-day morning, painted in ink and gouache: by the door on the left a hamster runs in its wheel in front of a long workbench covered in a tiny toy-factory world; a girl in a headband rides her bicycle across the room tossing newspapers from her basket; up on the wooden balcony a green parrot perches on a ship's wheel, a penguin holds up a diploma tied with red ribbon, a dalmatian in a red fire helmet barks by a gushing red pump and a juggler on a park bench keeps three balls in the air; below, a young apprentice painter stirs his paint bucket over a huge colorful splat while a wise old woman watches, a nervous intern takes notes on a little curtained stage, and a businessman bends to shake the paw of a sitting red fox.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the mustard door to the hall

zooms.label: l'établi
zooms.hint: Look closer at the workbench of figurines

etabli.name: L'établi des apprentis
etabli.alt: A close-up of the apprentices' workbench by the glass door, at bench-top level in warm late-afternoon light, with golden autumn trees outside and the ocher wall behind. The bench top is a busy little toy world: a smiling boss figure waves a line of tiny workers in through a toy factory gate; a toy tennis pro leaps to serve an ace; an apprentice's hands let a paper crane flap away; a toy worker carries a stack of bricks to a half-built wall; a toy technician with a wrench fixes a little tin robot; and a toy coach with a whistle cheers a row of racing cars zooming to the edge of the bench, among sawdust, a pot of brushes and fallen leaves.

gardes.name: La galerie des gardes
gardes.alt: The guards' gallery at dusk on a windy autumn evening, painted in ink and gouache from low by the floor: a crescent moon and golden trees show through the open glass door on the left, and brass lanterns glow on the ocher walls. A nanny sings as she pushes a big black stroller; a damsel holds a ladder against an indoor tree where a knight in armor is stuck on a branch; on a round rug a babysitter reads a picture book to a sleepy little girl; a supervisor on a ladder holds up a lantern over children writing at tiny exam desks; a blacksmith hammers by a glowing forge, sparks flying; a boy joiner taps a wooden easel with his mallet; a hedgehog opens the door of the little house he built; and a tin can floats down the stone gutter. High on the right wall a shelf holds a toy building site.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the slate-blue door to the hall

zooms.label: l'étagère
zooms.hint: Look closer at the toy building site on the high shelf

tablette.name: L'étagère des gardes
tablette.alt: A close-up at the guards' high wall shelf at dusk: a toy copper water main has burst and sprays a glittering jet while a little plumber in blue overalls heaves on the red valve wheel, the water running away along a small stone canal; in a picket-fence play pen three toddlers laugh and build with colored blocks in the spray while their caregiver stands guard at the gate; and on a mound of fresh earth a property developer in a yellow hard hat waves the little red flag he has just planted, a toy wheelbarrow beside him.

savants.name: La galerie des savants
savants.alt: The scholars' gallery as a small wooden lecture amphitheater seen from the back row, curved honey-oak tiers stepping down to a round floor, autumn trees in the tall windows and a teal door ajar at the top. A man shakes his big shaggy dog's paw while a dove flies above and a cat watches; a proud young woman holds up a framed certificate; a white cat in a tiny tiara sits on a crate; a woman analyst peers at a line chart through a magnifying glass; a nervous intern on a little box stage holds a big coat; a teacher leads two little girls by the hand down the aisle; a girl squeezes a fat book; an electrician on a stepladder fixes the fuse box, sparks flying; an insurance agent holds a blue umbrella over an old lady; and on a podium a graduation photo is taken with a flash: a graduate with her scroll, a young doctor with a little girl and an academician with a long quill.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the navy door to the hall

zooms.label: la console
zooms.hint: Look closer at the graduation photo on the podium

console.name: La console des savants
console.alt: A close-up of the graduation photo on the podium in the scholars' amphitheater: on the left a photographer in a flat cap squeezes the bulb of an old box camera and the flash pops in a burst of light; on the podium a young graduate in gown and mortarboard jumps and thrusts her scroll high; a young doctor crouches to listen to a giggling little girl's chest with his stethoscope; and an old academician in an embroidered blue coat and tricorn hat raises his long white quills.
